professional.caseStudy: Pitch Intel is an enterprise sales enablement platform that uses LLM-driven content workflows to generate tailored sales pitches. The platform integrates with company-specific brand tokens and review workflows to ensure content accuracy and compliance.
fullDetails: Shipped a data-driven experience for enterprise sales teams with real-time pitch generation.
Improved content accuracy through brand tokens and company-specific content controls.
Built review workflows enabling sales managers to approve and refine generated pitches.
Scaled the AI service to multi-tenant operations with reduced processing latency.
